copilotMemory.value: GURU-XD operates on Linux x86_64 Cloud Run, Node v22, Express backend CJS bundle, Single-Page React 18 client, JSON persistence store, Baileys MD WhatsApp socket layer, and Telegraf Telegram daemons.
Baileys socket daemons require session credential restoration from /sessions, automatic reconnect backoff loops, and passing { quoted: message } for thread context.
Sandbox scripts must export an async function (client, message, args). Forbidden: eval(), child_process, process.exit, and plain-text API secrets.
Dashboard, Bot Daemons, Custom Command Registry, Plugins System, Live Terminal Diagnostics, MongoDB Schemas, AI Copilot Engine V4 with AI Brain Orchestration.

copilotPrompts.title: Build Weather Command
copilotPrompts.description: Generates an automated weather forecast command script with emoji formatting.
copilotPrompts.promptText: Write a JavaScript WhatsApp bot command handler triggered by '.weather <city>' that fetches current weather from a simulated API and formats a gorgeous emoji-rich card response.

copilotPrompts.title: Create Anti-Spam Filter
copilotPrompts.description: Group moderation script to detect unauthorized channel links and auto-kick spammers.
copilotPrompts.promptText: Build a group moderation command script triggered by '.spamshield' that detects links containing invite channels and auto-kicks the participant with customized logs.

copilotPrompts.title: Analyze Cluster Logs
copilotPrompts.description: Parses active terminal log history to diagnose crashes and suggest fixes.
copilotPrompts.promptText: Review the current active system log lines, analyze failures, identify socket disconnect causes, and suggest the exact configuration corrections to prevent crash state loops.

copilotPrompts.title: Create Economy Quiz Game
copilotPrompts.description: Interactive chat trivia mini-game handler with coin reward distribution.
copilotPrompts.promptText: Generate an interactive chat trivia mini-game handler triggered by '.quiz' that gives participants coins in our economy ledger database upon answering correct.

copilotPrompts.title: Full Security Vulnerability Audit
copilotPrompts.description: Performs a deep scan on custom commands and active API routes for security risks.
copilotPrompts.promptText: Perform a comprehensive security audit of all custom bot commands, checking for unhandled exceptions, command injection, and API token exposure.

copilotPrompts.title: Design Analytics Schema
copilotPrompts.description: Generates MongoDB schema and Mongoose model for chat telemetry.
copilotPrompts.promptText: Design a production-grade MongoDB schema for tracking bot chat messages, user interaction frequency, and latency benchmarks.
